Name: Victor - Stardew Valley Expanded
Author: ThePaleRose
Description:
[b][u]﻿YOU NEED STARDEW VALLEY EXPANDED FOR THIS[/u][/b]

Hiya! This is my first time posting on Nexus, ever, so if I did something wrong please tell me! I wasn't very satisfied with the original Victor portrait, so I decided to make one for my personal use. It's not very well done, as I haven't ever made a portrait before, so I think I might redo it again in the future, with better art. The file just includes the png I made, so to install it you just need to replace the victor portrait png with mine in the images section of his assets folder. If I explained it wrong or you have any issues or suggestions, please message me! Note that the portrait may look a little smaller than base game portraits. This is because I used the placement of the original portrait of victor. I'll fix that if I ever update this! Thank you for checking my mod out <3

Downloads.Description: This is the same thing just in a bit of an updated art style. I'd recommend using this one instead of the first version, but thats up to you. Both work.
